access.stage.title:
Understand life.
Shape what comes next.
access.stage.body: A personal space to understand what is happening, preserve continuity over time, and decide what comes next.
access.stage.foot: One reality. More than one way to understand it.
access.signin.title: Sign in to DANTE
access.signin.body: Continue with your account or use email and password.
access.signup.title: Create your DANTE account
access.signup.body: Use an email address you can access. We’ll ask you to verify it.
access.signupPassword.title: Protect your account
access.signupPassword.body: Choose a long, unique password. You can use one generated by your password manager.
access.password.unique: Use a long, unique phrase that is easy for you to remember
access.password.manager: You can paste or generate the password with your password manager
access.password.note: Your password only protects access to your DANTE account. Profile setup comes later.
access.signup.legalPrefix: By creating the account, you agree to the
access.signup.legalMiddle: and confirm you have read the
access.provider.body: DANTE opens the provider’s official flow. The consent screen belongs to the provider, not DANTE.
access.provider.scopeNote: Google/Apple sign-in authenticates your account. It does not automatically grant access to Calendar, Gmail, or iCloud.
access.legal.prefix: By continuing, you agree to the
access.verify.title: Check your email
access.verify.body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to verify the address.
access.verify.privacy: The code is single-use and expires automatically.
access.forgot.title: Recover access
access.forgot.body: We’ll send a secure link to set a new password.
access.forgot.privacy: The response is intentionally neutral: we do not confirm whether an address is registered.
access.recovery.title: Check your email
access.recovery.body: If an account exists for the address you entered, you’ll receive instructions to recover access.
access.reset.title: Create a new password
access.reset.body: The new password will replace the previous one.
access.reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
access.providerError.title: Sign-in not completed
access.providerError.body: The provider did not complete authentication. No changes were applied to your account.
access.providerError.retry: Try again or choose another method.
access.link.title: Confirm account linking
access.link.body: A DANTE account already exists for this email. Sign in to that account before linking the provider.
access.setupName.title: What should DANTE call you?
access.setupName.body: This only makes the experience more natural. You can change it anytime.
access.setupName.label: Preferred name
access.setupLocale.title: Language and time zone
access.setupLocale.body: DANTE uses these to show dates and times correctly. We prefilled what we can reliably detect.
access.setupLocale.note: We are not inferring preferences here; you are confirming operational settings.
access.setupStart.title: Where do you want to start?
access.setupStart.body: Pick a path. None of these choices are permanent.
access.start.realBody: An event, activity, routine, or goal.
access.start.importBody: Bring in an existing calendar or file.
access.start.demoBody: Try the interaction without creating real data.
access.start.skipBody: Enter Home now. You can resume guidance later.
access.firstAction.title: Create your first real thing
access.firstAction.body: Start with something simple. You can add details later.
access.firstAction.label: What do you want to add?
access.import.title: Import into your space
access.import.body: Import is separate from sign-in: using Google to log in does not authorize DANTE to read your calendar.
access.import.file: Import a calendar file without linking an account.
access.demo.title: A demo that never pollutes your data
access.demo.body: The item below is tutorial-only and never enters your real history.
access.demo.itemBody: You can open, move, complete, or delete it during the tour.
access.home.title: You’re ready
access.home.body: Initial setup is complete. DANTE opens Home from here and guidance continues only when useful.
access.reauth.title: Session expired
access.reauth.body: Sign in again to continue. Your current context is preserved.
